I implemented `set Iterator.prototype.constructor` with a local `SetterThatIgnoresPrototypeProperties`. The build passes, but 0 of 4 runs in `built-ins/Iterator/prototype/constructor/` pass, so the ticket's target is not met. I didn't run clippy in the end.

Two things outside my file scope keep the accessor from being tested:
- **`table.rs` overwrites the accessor:** the "constructor.prototype and prototype.constructor links" loop (lines 901-902) replaces the `Iterator.prototype.constructor` accessor from `generated.rs` with a data property. It needs to skip the Iterator constructor.
- **The getter is a stub:** `get Iterator.prototype.constructor` in `prototype_get_constructor.rs` still returns not-implemented. It is a separate file, so I left it.

The `SetterThatIgnoresPrototypeProperties` helper is private to my file. `prototype_set_symbol_to_string_tag.rs` will need the same operation, so it could be moved into `support/`.
